sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet and Claude Code
sources.evidence: February 24, 2025 announcement introduces Claude 3.7 Sonnet, with standard responses and optional extended thinking, and describes coding and agentic capabilities. The dated announcement establishes public release, rather than the earlier date embedded in the API identifier.

sources.title: Claude 3.7 Sonnet System Card
sources.evidence: The 43-page card identifies a hybrid reasoning model in the Claude 3 family and explains optional extended thinking, reinforcement learning and training data. It supplies neither a production parameter count nor a dense/MoE architecture specification.

sources.title: Claude 4 System Card
sources.evidence: Later first-party system card contains exact-name Claude Sonnet 3.7 comparisons. The accessed card and parameter-term search do not supply total or active parameter counts for Sonnet 3.7; evaluation scores are not model sizes.

sources.title: Emergent Introspective Awareness in Large Language Models
sources.evidence: October 29, 2025 research explicitly includes production Sonnet 3.7 in Methods Notes. It describes layerwise residual-stream interventions across those models and frames their mechanisms as transformer-based. This supports a generic Transformer label, not dense/MoE topology, layer counts or parameter counts.

sources.title: Anthropic's Transparency Hub — Claude 3.7 Sonnet summary
sources.evidence: The exact-model summary identifies Claude 3.7 Sonnet as a Claude 3 hybrid reasoning model, with text and image input and text-only output, and says it is retired. Its architecture section discusses training methods but discloses no production parameter counts.

sources.title: Model deprecations
sources.evidence: The exact API ID claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219 is retired. Deprecation was announced October 28, 2025 and retirement occurred February 19, 2026. The page uses the name Claude Sonnet 3.7.

sources.title: GLM-5.3 and the spread of advanced cyber capabilities
sources.evidence: Anthropic explicitly states that Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. This is first-party evidence about weight availability independent of the existence of a hosted API; the paper's benchmark models are newer Claude versions.

sources.title: Claude on Amazon Bedrock (Opus 4.6 and earlier)
sources.evidence: The model table maps Sonnet 3.7 to anthropic.claude-3-7-sonnet-20250219-v1:0 and marks it retired. The context section assigns 200K to Claude models outside its explicit 1M-model list; Sonnet 3.7 is not in that list.

sources.title: Partner model deprecations — Claude 3.7 Sonnet on Google Cloud
sources.evidence: Retained provider card specifies 200,000 input tokens, text/code/image input, text output, function calling and PDF-document specifications. It inconsistently lists extended thinking as unsupported and gives a March 20, 2025 provider version date; neither overrides Anthropic's launch announcement. The page retains prospective shutdown wording despite the elapsed May 11, 2026 date.

sources.title: Bash tool
sources.evidence: Tool version documentation explicitly says bash_20250124 is supported from Claude Sonnet 3.7 onward and marks Sonnet 3.7 retired. This confirms documented tool calling, not current endpoint operation.

sources.title: Claude Model Pricing — List Prices by Platform, effective May 12, 2026
sources.evidence: Page 3 lists both 200K and 1M Claude API pricing rows under Claude 3.7 Sonnet; pages 6 and 9–10 list only 200K for Bedrock and Vertex. The API pricing row postdates the documented API retirement and is not accompanied by a verified availability announcement or model specification establishing 1M support.

sources.title: Anthropic Claude Messages API — Request and Response
sources.evidence: The beta compatibility table explicitly distinguishes Sonnet 3.7's output-128k-2025-02-19 output extension from the context-1m-2025-08-07 feature, whose model list excludes Sonnet 3.7. Output limits must not be treated as context limits.

sources.title: Claude Sonnet 4.5 System Card
sources.evidence: Parent retrieved the full 149-page PDF with curl and pdftotext after the browsing size-limit failure. Exact Sonnet 3.7 comparisons concern CyberGym and reward-hacking evaluations; the extracted full document has no model-parameter count disclosure for Sonnet 3.7.

sources.title: Commercial Terms of Service
sources.evidence: Anthropic retains intellectual-property rights in its services and restricts reverse engineering and duplication. Together with the explicit non-distribution of Claude weights, supports the descriptive proprietary classification.

sources.title: Citations API and PDF support for Claude models now in Amazon Bedrock
sources.evidence: June 30, 2025 announcement explicitly includes Claude Sonnet 3.7 among models supporting PDF input through InvokeModel and Converse.

name.note: Anthropic uses both Claude 3.7 Sonnet at launch and Claude Sonnet 3.7 in current lifecycle documentation. The baseline name is supported.

developer.note: Developer attribution is explicit in the announcement and authored system card.

family.note: Catalog-normalized Sonnet lineage; the system card also places this model within the broader Claude 3 family.

release_date.note: Public release is February 24, 2025. The 20250219 suffix identifies the snapshot; Google's March 20 date is provider-specific and is not the earliest public release.

open_weights.note: Anthropic explicitly says Claude weights are not publicly released or provided to users. The exact-model release has no weight-distribution artifact. The conclusion is not based solely on API hosting.

license.note: Descriptive classification of the closed proprietary model and service; not a downloadable-weight redistribution license.

parameters_b.note: No total count is disclosed in the exact-model card, later Claude 4 and Sonnet 4.5 comparisons, transparency summary or exact-model interpretability study. No sibling size or interpretability feature count is substituted.

active_parameters_b.note: No separately defined active parameter count was found in the accessed sources or later exact-name disclosure searches. Dense/MoE topology is not established, and an active count cannot be inferred.

architecture.note: Supported at the broad architecture level by the interpretability paper's transformer-based framing and layerwise residual-stream methods, explicitly applied to production Sonnet 3.7. This contextual inference does not establish dense versus MoE, layer dimensions or exact architecture details.

context_window.note: Retain the documented 200K context as a historical specification. A post-retirement Anthropic pricing PDF also lists a 1M API tier, conflicting with the model documentation; no corroborating exact-model availability announcement or supported-context specification was found. The 128K beta is an output extension, not 1M context support.

modalities.note: Anthropic explicitly documents text/image inputs and text output. AWS explicitly added PDF support for exact Sonnet 3.7 in June 2025; PDF is a supported file format processed through text and vision. These are historical capabilities.

reasoning.note: Optional extended thinking is explicit in Anthropic's launch and system card. Google's retained card lists extended thinking as unsupported, a provider-documentation conflict that does not override the developer's exact-model evidence.

tool_call.note: Anthropic's tool-version documentation explicitly covers Sonnet 3.7, corroborated by the retained provider function-calling specification. This does not claim an operational retired API endpoint.

description.value: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet model with optional extended thinking, text and image understanding, and tool use for coding and analysis.
description.note: Replace the generic cost-control characterization with directly documented model capabilities. Retirement and context conflicts are recorded separately in notes.

patch.description: Anthropic's Claude Sonnet model with optional extended thinking, text and image understanding, and tool use for coding and analysis.
patch.notes: The snapshot identifier contains February 19; public availability began February 24, 2025. Anthropic retired this API ID on February 19, 2026; capabilities here are historical documented specifications. Transformer structure is supported by exact-model interpretability research, but dense/MoE details and total/active parameter counts remain undisclosed. Retain the documented 200K context: Anthropic's May 12, 2026 pricing PDF contains conflicting 1M API rows after retirement, without a corroborating exact-model availability specification. The 128K beta extended output, not context. Google's retained card also conflicts with Anthropic's explicit extended-thinking support.
